rubric_hint.rule: contradiction: effort 11 below county median 66 while 4 threatened species are recorded within 1000 m
rubric_hint.basis: prompts/rubric.md v1 applied to all rings 0-1000 m and effort; a default, not a verdict

override_reason.text: The mechanical MEDIUM comes from a contradiction (low effort versus threatened species within 1000 m). The threatened species are all mobile birds, with no eligible site-bound species, so they say nothing about the stand. The contradiction is resolved, and the below-median effort falls through to UNDER_SURVEYED. LOW is not allowed at below-median effort.

reasons.claim: 2.04 ha regeneration felling notified 2026-10-02. Completed felling overlaps 6.8% (0.14 ha, dated 2007), well below 50%, so not ALREADY_FELLED.

No records inside or within 250 m, and no eligible species. Recording effort is low: 11 records, 5 observation days, 16th percentile, against a county median of 66. Near-site effort is 0 records within 250 m against a county median of 3.

The four threatened species within 1000 m are all mobile birds (Apus apus, Surnia ulula, Vanellus vanellus, Calidris pugnax) at 576-721 m. There are 0 eligible species. The two forest-associated ones are supporting evidence only. Two records (2017) have 1000 m uncertainty.

uncertainties: The few records reflect low recording effort and say little about what lives on the site.
The two forest-associated VU birds are mobile, so their records at ~576 m do not locate habitat on the polygon.
I relied on the 250 m and 1000 m ring outputs only; I did not query the intermediate rings.
not_established: That the site lacks red-listed or site-bound species.
That the site holds any eligible species.
The stand's age, structure or habitat value.
Anything about sensitive species hidden from public data.
next_action: A reviewer should consider a field inventory or a habitat-map check, since open data are too sparse to judge the site. They should also check whether any other records exist outside Artportalen.
